name: Zoom
summary: A private app only works for users on your own Zoom account. To let other companies connect, you need Zoom's approval: a beta review to share with a few external users, or a Marketplace review to publish (listed or unlisted).
scenario: An agent that schedules meetings and fetches recordings and transcripts for users in other Zoom accounts.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the Zoom toolkit.

portal.accountNeeded: A Zoom account with developer access to the App Marketplace.

policyAndDomain.detail: Published and unlisted apps need listing metadata (images, descriptions, categories) or they fail review.

userCapBeforeApproval.detail: Private apps are restricted to users on your account; approved beta apps reach only a limited number of external users for a limited time.

businessVerification.detail: Not described on the page checked.

adminApproval.detail: Admin-managed apps are added by account admins; user-managed apps are authorized per user.

appReview.detail: Required before anyone outside your account can authorize: beta approval or a quality and security review for publishing.

securityAssessment.detail: Zoom describes a 'rigorous quality and security review' for published apps; whether that includes a third-party assessment isn't stated.

time.note: Zoom's key concepts page gives no review timeline. The range here is a placeholder estimate, not a sourced figure.

nextStep: Create a General (user-managed) OAuth app on the Zoom App Marketplace, test it with your own account, and prepare technical design documentation to request beta or publishing approval.

prerequisites.text: Technical design documentation and supporting evidence for Zoom's beta review.

steps.title: Create a user-managed OAuth app
steps.detail: On the App Marketplace build flow, create an app that users authorize individually with OAuth.

steps.title: Test inside your own account
steps.detail: Private apps work for users on your Zoom account via the authorization URL.

steps.title: Request beta approval for pilots
steps.detail: Ask Zoom for approval to share the authorization URL with external users; Zoom reviews your technical design docs.

steps.title: Submit for publishing (listed or unlisted)
steps.detail: Complete listing metadata and submit for the quality and security review. Unlisted apps are still reviewed.

review.summary: Needed for any external account: beta approval for limited pilots, or full review to publish.
triggers: Sharing with users outside your Zoom account
Joining meetings hosted by other accounts (requires unlisted or published)
review.meanwhile: Use and demo the app inside your own Zoom account.

blockers.issue: Customer gets an error authorizing your app.
blockers.fix: Private apps only work on your account. Request beta approval or publish (unlisted is fine).
Unlisted apps still need images, descriptions and categories.

nuances.text: Admin-managed apps act for a whole account; user-managed apps need each user to authorize.

uncertainties: Scope names not checked in this pass.

sources.title: Zoom: Key concepts for the Developer Platform

corrections: Expected unpublished OAuth apps to work for anyone with the link. Zoom restricts private apps to your own account; external use needs beta approval or publishing.
